import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_colors = {'Full Frame': '#e74c3c', 'APS-C': '#3498db', 'Micro 4/3': '#2ecc71', 'Medium Format': '#f39c12'}
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, 
               color=sensor_colors.get(sensor, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(brand_counts)))
ax2.barh(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Camera Brands', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Average price by sensor type and 4K capability
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
price_by_sensor_4k = df.groupby(['sensor_type', 'has_video_4k'])['price_usd'].mean().unstack()
price_by_sensor_4k.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#95a5a6', '#e67e22'], width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Avg Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Avg Price: 4K vs Non-4K', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(['No 4K', '4K'], title='Video Capability', frameon=True)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Weight vs Price colored by body type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
body_colors = plt.cm.tab10(np.linspace(0, 1, len(body_types)))
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=40, label=body, color=body_colors[i])
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Camera Weight vs Price by Body Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.legend(title='Body Type', ncol=2, frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Evolution of megapixels over years
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
yearly_mp = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': ['mean', 'min', 'max']
}).reset_index()
yearly_mp.columns = ['model_year', 'mean', 'min', 'max']
ax5.plot(yearly_mp['model_year'], yearly_mp['mean'], 
        marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, color='#3498db', label='Average')
ax5.fill_between(yearly_mp['model_year'], yearly_mp['min'], yearly_mp['max'], 
                 alpha=0.2, color='#3498db', label='Min-Max Range')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Evolution of Camera Megapixels Over Time', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. ISO capability distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['iso_category'] = pd.cut(df['max_iso'], bins=[0, 6400, 25600, 102400, np.inf], 
                             labels=['≤6400', '6401-25600', '25601-102400', '>102400'])
iso_dist = df['iso_category'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors_iso = ['#95a5a6', '#3498db', '#e67e22', '#e74c3c']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(iso_dist.values, labels=iso_dist.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_iso, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax6.set_title('Max ISO Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
